gradient_audit.note: Supervised gradients before optimizer/weight decay. Heldout-only registered relations remain present; zero is expected. A supported zero message gradient is explicitly recorded; single-edge attention softmax can legitimately have zero gradient.

B.gradient_validation_note: Frozen shallow registration permits G3R identity; deep registration rejects topology. This is not production checkpoint acceptance.

C.limitation: Random same-file endpoints, current mappable guards only; no EdgeAware attribute activations, backward or optimizer state. CPU RSS is not GPU VRAM.

discrepancies.finding: Modifier _anchor is modifier_invocation, not the guard statement in its body; all modifier records unmapped.
discrepancies.proposal: Later add an EdgeSem-local read-only provenance resolver using frozen binding/guard logic; do not edit NodeSem. Requires approval before implementation.

discrepancies.finding: Existing checkpoint.validate_binding imports frozen runtime registration; neither G3R nor G3R-T can pass typed deep validation.
discrepancies.proposal: An EdgeSem-local binding adapter must dispatch to its own registration. A profile string alone is insufficient. No bypass implemented.

discrepancies.finding: L1 kind includes return; variable facts lack declaration type; state.writes.shape describes root declaration type rather than scalar/member access.
discrepancies.proposal: Decide return-kind mapping and exact declaration/access joins before attribute implementation; do not silently coerce or broaden schemas.

discrepancies.finding: READS_STATE starts at a state declaration; intra-function def-to-use path is not directly defined for that source.
discrepancies.proposal: Specify applicability/unknown handling for cross-call attribute on READS_STATE; do not invent a reaching definition.

discrepancies.finding: Renamed source cannot be checked against unchanged original code text by Projector.
discrepancies.proposal: Reuse existing temporary node_code_view for parity only; all 384 task/file identities pass; formal graph stays original.

discrepancies.finding: Section 1.4 gives contract LR values; node tasks use initial_lr=.0002/max_lr=.005/div_factor=25.
discrepancies.proposal: Bind future execution to task-specific sealed configuration; r3 introduction already acknowledges node max_lr.

final_server_intent: Final experiments will use a sufficiently provisioned server in a separate batch; RTX3050 4GiB is only the local development constraint.
